historicalAllocationDrift.rule: Do not silently choose either historical allocation. A new versioned ZVQ allocation policy requires explicit governance approval and evidence.
historicalAllocationDrift.note: The proposed 70M ZVQ circulating target is not equivalent to the historical 70M KAM Liquidity & Market Development allocation.

whyPublicRpcIsInsufficient: ZVQ is the native coin, not an ERC-20 token with a canonical totalSupply() method. Public JSON-RPC can verify chain identity, blocks and balances for known addresses, but it cannot by itself prove the complete native supply without the canonical production genesis/allocation state and any documented issuance rules.
requiredEvidenceBeforeCanonicalZvqSupply: Aggregate production genesis allocation total for Chain ID 22028.
SHA-256 or equivalent immutable hash of the production genesis artifact or an independently reproducible canonical genesis reference.
Evidence that the running production chain is the chain created from that genesis reference.
Canonical allocation wallet list or a public allocation-accounting method.
Current balances for allocation wallets at a recorded block height.
Lock, vesting, governance or transfer-restriction evidence for non-circulating balances.
Documented issuance, validator reward, burn or supply-change behavior actually implemented by the network.
A reproducible circulating-supply calculation with timestamp and block height.
Explicit governance approval for changing the legacy 50M target to the proposed 70M ZVQ target.
Explicit governance approval resolving the two conflicting historical allocation baselines.
